config.prompt: Humari company ek software provide karti hai jo aapki payment collection ko streamline karta hai, aur saath hi E-invoice aur E-way bill generation mein bhi help karta hai. config.responseDirective: Reply in the SAME language the customer is speaking - English for an English customer, Hinglish for a Hindi, Hinglish or mixed customer. Never use a gendered honorific: no Sir and no Maam, and never guess gender from the voice. Say two things in one turn and nothing else. First the company introduction: CredFlow provides software that streamlines payment collection and also helps with E-invoice and E-way bill generation, and it integrates easily with the customer's existing accounting software. Then ask which accounting software they use in their business. No pricing, no other feature, no demo offer yet, no second question.

nodes.label: Demo Date (time bhi capture karta hai)

config.question: Kya aap mujhe ek convenient date aur time bata sakte hain demo ke liye?
config.responseDirective: Reply in the SAME language the customer is speaking - English for an English customer, Hinglish for a Hindi, Hinglish or mixed customer. Never use a gendered honorific: no Sir and no Maam, and never guess gender from the voice. Ask for a convenient date and time for the demo. One question only. Never say the demo is booked or confirmed - only the customer's preference is being noted.

config.question: Aapne jo date choose ki hai, uske liye kya aap time bata sakte hain?
config.responseDirective: Reply in the SAME language the customer is speaking - English for an English customer, Hinglish for a Hindi, Hinglish or mixed customer. Never use a gendered honorific: no Sir and no Maam, and never guess gender from the voice. The demo date is already captured in preferred_date. Say it back as an explicit calendar date, then ask ONLY for the time. To get that date, read today's date from the 'Current date and time' section and compute from it on THIS call: aaj/today is that date; kal/tomorrow is that date plus one day; parso/day after tomorrow is that date plus two days; a weekday name is the next occurrence of that weekday after today; an explicit date the customer gave is itself. Speak the result as day plus month name. Never reuse a date from an example, from an earlier conversation or from memory, and never repeat the relative word back to the customer. If the 'Current date and time' section is missing, ask the customer for a specific date instead of guessing. Never ask for the date again, never invent a time, never say the demo is booked.

config.text: Thank you. Aapki demo ki preferred date aur time note kar liya hai.
config.responseDirective: Reply in the SAME language the customer is speaking - English for an English customer, Hinglish for a Hindi, Hinglish or mixed customer. Never use a gendered honorific: no Sir and no Maam, and never guess gender from the voice. Confirm the captured slot in one short sentence: the date as an explicit calendar date and the time exactly as the customer gave it, then thank them. To get that date, read today's date from the 'Current date and time' section and compute from it on THIS call: aaj/today is that date; kal/tomorrow is that date plus one day; parso/day after tomorrow is that date plus two days; a weekday name is the next occurrence of that weekday after today; an explicit date the customer gave is itself. Speak the result as day plus month name. Never reuse a date from an example, from an earlier conversation or from memory, and never repeat the relative word back to the customer. If the 'Current date and time' section is missing, ask the customer for a specific date instead of guessing. Say the preference has been noted - never that the demo is booked, scheduled or confirmed by the team.

config.text: Koi baat nahi, hum aapko baad mein call karke demo ka time fix kar lenge. Aapka time dene ke liye dhanyawaad.
